notes.title: Curious what Pocketwatch is making next? Come see an early development stream of our top-down Action RPG.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32938446/b2d3367bacb83dace8c17656f0492f794e7e0a85.png[/img]

Andy Schatz, creator of Monaco and Tooth and Tail, is streaming development of Pocketwatch's next game over on the [url=twitch.tv/pocketwatch]Pocketwatch Twitch channel[/url].  Code-named Bowhead, it's a top-down open world Action RPG with some Monaco-esque visibility and stealth.

Don't forget to follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32938446-Pocketwatch-Games/]Pocketwatch Creator page here on Steam[/url], [url=twitter.com/pocketwatchG]our Twitter[/url], and the Twitch channel or join our [url=discord.gg/pocketwatch]very active Discord channel[/url] for updates.

See you on stream!
